patches.audit_note: Reviewed available fee, geography and AI evidence; retained uncertainty where direct policy does not establish the claim.
Demoted AI compatibility because the journal-specific policy could not be checked and demoted publication fee because the cited journal-branded domain lacks confirmed official status.

ai_policy.summary: Elsevier journal policy permits human-directed drafting and explicitly does not prevent AI in study design, code development or data analysis; authors must verify outputs and retain intellectual responsibility. The journal-specific author guide was blocked, so stricter journal-specific conditions remain unverified.

disclosure.instructions: Describe AI research design and methods reproducibly in Methods. For manuscript preparation add declaration immediately before references naming tool, purpose, human review and responsibility.

restrictions: AI cannot be an author; do not replace intellectual contribution; restrictions apply to primary research images.

policy_sources.applicability: Elsevier journals author policy applies to publisher journal.
policy_sources.note: Study design, code and analysis plus drafting support and disclosures.
Returned 403; no journal-specific conflict could be checked.

route.conditions: Journal-branded third-party page reports no publication fee on a subscription route, but its official ownership is unverified. Publisher author guide was inaccessible; submission and publication charges remain unverified.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Mandatory page or length charges and membership are unverified.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-branded page states no publication fee for subscription; ownership of this external domain was not independently established.

findings.issue: Journal-specific author instructions blocked and cited fee page ownership unconfirmed. Publisher-wide AI policy alone does not eliminate possible journal-specific restrictions.
findings.resolution: Set AI compatibility unclear and publication fee unknown pending accessible official journal policy.

findings.issue: Current policy states $500 per accepted manuscript, superseding historical no-fee evidence.
findings.resolution: Retain not_free route and exclude from free directory.

findings.issue: Sage permits research code and primary or partial generated content with disclosure, but prohibits qualitative analysis of experiences and themes.
findings.resolution: Retain compatible classification for permitted workflows and preserve specific restrictions and disclosure.

findings.issue: Publisher journal page reports undated 2.9 impact factor and 19% acceptance rate without denominator.
findings.resolution: Retain as undated reported figures without implying personal acceptance probability.

notes: Reviewed all eight discovery IDs, fee, geography and AI role patches. Official publisher metrics located for Wiley journal; absence of a metric does not mean none exists.
Independent source inspection included Sage and Elsevier AI policies and Wiley journal metrics; other role evidence was critically reviewed. No subjective difficulty bands.
